placeholder.body: This screen will be built in a later step.

auth.signInLead: Sign in to your masjid or surau account.
auth.magicLead: Rather not type a password? We will email you a sign-in link.
auth.magicSent: If this email is registered, a sign-in link is on its way. Check your inbox (and spam folder).
auth.signUpLead: For committee members registering a masjid or surau. If you were invited, use the link in your invitation instead.
auth.signUpDone: Nearly done. We have sent a confirmation email. Click the link in it to continue.
auth.resetLead: Enter your email. We will send a link to set a new password.
auth.resetSent: If this email is registered, a link is on its way. Check your inbox.

onboarding.title: Register your masjid
onboarding.lead: You will be the Pengerusi for this masjid and can invite other committee members afterwards.
onboarding.name: Masjid or surau name
onboarding.nameHint: For example: Masjid Al-Hidayah Taman Seri Murni
onboarding.zoneHint: The JAKIM zone used for prayer times.
onboarding.invitedHint: Invited by another masjid? Open the invitation link you were sent.
onboarding.removedBody: Your account was deactivated by your masjid's Pengerusi. Contact the Pengerusi if this is a mistake.

invite.title: Invitation
invite.haveAccount: Already have an Imarah account with this email?
invite.wrongAccount: You are signed in as {email}. This invitation is for a different email. Sign out, then open this link again.

status.used: This invitation has already been used. Please sign in.
status.revoked: This invitation was cancelled. Ask the Pengerusi to send a new one.
status.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask the Pengerusi to send a new one.
status.not_found: This invitation link is not valid. Check the link you were given.

settings.title: Settings
settings.name: Name
settings.usersLead: Invite committee members, change roles, deactivate accounts
settings.logoLead: Upload a logo for the sidebar, e-receipts and reports
settings.fundsLead: Add, rename or archive funds and categories

users.title: Users
users.lead: Who can use Imarah for your masjid.
users.emailSent: Invitation sent to {email}. You can also share the link below.
users.emailNotSent: The invitation for {email} is ready. No email was sent, so copy the link below and share it yourself.
users.whatsappText: Assalamualaikum. You are invited to use Imarah for our masjid. Open this link: {link}
users.linkHelp: This link works for 7 days and only for the invited email. Do not share it in public groups.
users.confirmDeactivate: Deactivate {name}? They will no longer be able to sign in to this masjid.

forbidden.title: No access
forbidden.body: Your role does not allow this page. If you need it, ask the Pengerusi to change your role.

admin.signInLead: For the Imarah team only. Masjid accounts cannot sign in here.
admin.twoStepLead: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code.
admin.enrolLead: Admin accounts must use an authenticator app (for example Google Authenticator).
admin.enrolStep1: Open the authenticator app on your phone.
admin.enrolStep2: Scan the QR code below, or type the secret key.
admin.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
admin.loggedNotice: Every view and change here is recorded in that masjid's audit log.
admin.loadFailed: The masjid list could not be loaded.

email.inviteBody:
Assalamualaikum,

{masjid} has invited you to use Imarah as {role}.

Open this link to set your password and sign in:
{link}

The link works for 7 days. If you do not recognise this invitation, ignore this email.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.missing_fields: Please fill in every field correctly.
errors.invalid_credentials: Email or password is not correct.
errors.email_not_confirmed: Your email is not confirmed yet. Click the link in the confirmation email first.
errors.email_taken: This email is already registered. Please sign in.
errors.weak_password: The password needs at least 8 characters.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.link_expired: This link has expired or was already used. Please ask for a new one.
errors.password_mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
errors.platform_admin: Admin accounts cannot join a masjid.
errors.not_platform_admin: This is not an admin account.
errors.already_member: Your account already belongs to a masjid. One account is for one masjid only.
errors.already_in_masjid: This email is already an active member of your masjid.
errors.account_exists: This email already has an Imarah account.
errors.invitation_not_found: This invitation link is not valid.
errors.invitation_used: This invitation has already been used.
errors.invitation_wrong_email: This invitation is for a different email.
errors.name_required: Please fill in the masjid name.
errors.last_pengerusi: The masjid must keep at least one active Pengerusi.
errors.bad_code: That code is not correct. Try the latest code from your app.
errors.logo_too_big: This file is larger than 1 MB. Please make it smaller first.
errors.logo_wrong_type: Only PNG or SVG files are accepted.
errors.logo_unsafe_svg: This SVG contains code that is not allowed. Please export it again as a plain SVG or as a PNG.
errors.phone_bad: Phone number is not valid. For example: 012-345 6789.
errors.phone_excel: This phone number is damaged (for example 1.23E+09). Type the full number again.
errors.whatsapp_needs_mobile: WhatsApp consent needs a mobile number (starting 01).
errors.plan_limit: The Asas plan allows up to {limit} households. Upgrade the plan to add more.
errors.household_in_use: This household cannot be deleted because khairat or finance records refer to it.
errors.dob_bad: Date of birth is not valid.
errors.ic_bad: Enter only the last 4 digits of the IC number.
errors.csv_empty: The file is empty or has no data rows.
errors.csv_no_name_column: Name column not found. Use the template: the first row must have "nama_ketua".
errors.csv_too_many_rows: Too many rows (max 2,000). Split it into several files.
errors.import_partial: The import stopped part way. Check the kariah list before importing again.
errors.amount_bad: The amount is not valid. Write it like 1234.50 or 1,234.50 (at most 2 decimal places).
errors.amount_zero: The amount must be more than RM 0.00.
errors.amount_too_big: The amount is too large for one entry (maximum RM 10,000,000.00).
errors.date_future: The date cannot be after today. Record it when the money is actually received or paid.
errors.ref_too_long: The reference is too long (maximum 60 characters).
errors.note_too_long: The note is too long (maximum 500 characters).
errors.attachment_too_big: The attachment is larger than 5 MB. Take the photo at a lower resolution or make the PDF smaller.
errors.attachment_wrong_type: The attachment must be a JPG, PNG or WebP picture, or a PDF.
errors.attachment_failed: The attachment could not be uploaded. Check the internet connection and try again.
errors.locked_month: This month is locked, so entries cannot be added to it. Use a date in an open month, or ask the Pengerusi to unlock that month.
errors.fund_archived: This fund is archived. Choose another fund, or bring it back under Settings > Funds & categories.
errors.category_archived: This category is archived. Choose another category.
errors.category_mismatch: This category does not match the kind of entry (receive or pay).
errors.reason_missing: Please write the reason for cancelling.
errors.reason_too_long: The reason is too long (maximum 300 characters).
errors.reverse_reversal: A cancelling entry cannot itself be cancelled.
errors.reversal_before_original: A cancellation cannot be dated before the original entry.
errors.fund_not_empty: This fund still has a balance. Only a fund with RM 0.00 can be archived.
errors.already_reversed: This entry has already been cancelled.
errors.name_taken: This name is already used. Choose another name.
errors.not_allowed: Your role does not allow this.
errors.plan_limit_funds: The Asas plan allows at most {limit} active funds. Archive a fund you do not use or upgrade the plan.
errors.fund_name_too_long: The name is too long (maximum 60 characters).
errors.own_count: You cannot confirm your own count. Ask someone else to confirm it.
errors.breakdown_mismatch: The note breakdown does not match the amount. Check the number of each note again.
errors.needs_recount: This count must be recounted before it can be confirmed.
errors.collection_closed: This count has already been confirmed or cancelled, so it cannot be changed.
errors.offline_not_kept: There is no signal and this phone could not keep the count. Write the amount on paper and try again when there is signal.
errors.email_off: Email is not set up for this app yet.
errors.email_bad: The email address is not valid.
errors.receipt_cancelled: This receipt was cancelled and cannot be sent.
errors.email_failed: The email could not be sent. Please try again.
errors.received_from_too_long: The donor name is too long (100 characters at most).
errors.credit_asas: The Asas plan always shows "Generated by Imarah".
errors.khairat_plan: Khairat is on Standard plans and above.
errors.khairat_overpaid: The amount is more than this year's balance. A payment for another year is recorded on that year's membership.
errors.khairat_no_setup: Khairat fees for this year are not set up yet.
errors.khairat_pay_by: The last day to pay must be in the same year.
errors.khairat_year_taken: This year already has fee settings.
errors.duitnow_missing: Upload a QR picture or paste the QR text.
errors.duitnow_bad: This is not a DuitNow QR. Make sure it is the QR for receiving payments from the masjid's bank.
errors.duitnow_damaged: The QR text is incomplete or mistyped (the final check does not match). Upload the QR picture again.
errors.duitnow_not_malaysia: This QR is not for Malaysia (RM). Use the masjid's DuitNow QR.
errors.duitnow_too_long: The QR text is too long.
errors.duitnow_confirm: Tick to confirm this name is the masjid's bank account.
errors.bank_file_missing: Choose a bank statement CSV file.
errors.bank_file_too_big: The file is too big (limit 900 KB). Download a statement for a shorter period.
errors.bank_header_missing: The chosen columns are not in this file. Choose "New bank" and choose the columns again.
errors.bank_no_lines: There are no transaction lines in this file.
errors.bank_too_many: Too many lines (limit 5,000). Download a statement for a shorter period.
errors.bank_date_bad: the date could not be read
errors.bank_amount_bad: the amount could not be read
errors.bank_both_sides: there is an amount in both debit and credit
errors.bank_format_name_too_long: The bank name is too long (limit 60 characters).
errors.bank_format_name_taken: This bank name is already used. Choose that bank in the list, or give another name.
errors.bank_columns_same: The debit and credit columns must be different.
errors.bank_nothing_new: Every line is already imported. Nothing is added.
errors.bank_amount_mismatch: The entry's amount or direction is not the same as the bank line.
errors.bank_entry_cancelled: This entry was cancelled and cannot be matched.
errors.bank_entry_cash: Cash entries do not go through the bank. If it was really a bank transfer, cancel it and record it again with the right method.
errors.bank_entry_taken: This entry is already matched to another bank line.
errors.bank_line_taken: This bank line is already matched or marked.
errors.bank_import_matched: This import has lines that are matched or marked. Unmatch them first.
errors.period_pending_collections: A Friday collection in this month is not confirmed or is waiting for a recount. Finish it first.
errors.period_not_ended: This month has not ended, so it cannot be locked yet.
errors.period_reason_too_long: The reason is too long (limit 300 characters).
errors.period_warnings_unread: Tick that you have read the warnings before locking.

logo.title: Masjid logo
logo.lead: The logo shows in the sidebar and app, and later on e-receipts, kariah cards and monthly reports.
logo.noLogo: No logo yet. The masjid's initials are shown for now.
logo.fileHint: PNG or SVG, up to 1 MB. A square logo works best.
logo.confirmRemove: Remove this logo? The masjid's initials will show instead.

kariah.title: Kariah
kariah.empty: No households yet. Add one or import from CSV.
kariah.memberCount: {count, plural, =0 {no members} one {# member} other {# members}}
kariah.phoneHint: For example: 012-345 6789. Leave empty if none.
kariah.consentDateNote: The consent date is recorded automatically when a box is ticked.

consent.whatsappText: This household agrees to receive masjid announcements and reminders by WhatsApp. They can withdraw at any time.
consent.pdpaText: This household agrees that the details above are kept by the masjid for kariah and khairat matters only, and not shared with others.

kariah.icNote: Only the last 4 digits of the IC number are stored. The full number is never stored.
kariah.icTrimmed: The full number was cut. Only the last 4 digits will be stored.
kariah.confirmDeleteHousehold: Delete the household of {name} and all its members? This cannot be undone.

kariahImport.title: Import households from CSV
kariahImport.lead: One row per household. Nothing is saved until you check the preview and press Import.
kariahImport.templateHelp: Fill in the template in Excel or Google Sheets, then save it as CSV. Columns: nama_ketua, alamat, telefon, whatsapp (ya/tidak), pdpa (ya/tidak).
kariahImport.counts: {valid} rows ready to import, {invalid} rows have errors and will be skipped.
kariahImport.overLimit: Your plan allows only {room} more households. Remove some rows or upgrade the plan.

rowError.phone_excel: Excel damaged the phone number (for example 1.23E+09). Type it again as text.
rowError.consent_bad: The whatsapp and pdpa columns must be "ya" or "tidak"

kariahImport.confirmHelp: Only rows without errors are imported. For rows with errors, fix them in the file and import again later.

history.title: Change history
history.lead: Who changed what, and when. For personal details only the fact of a change is recorded, not its content.

utama.title: Finance summary
utama.totalNote: Current balance of all funds, including restricted funds.
utama.totalsOnly: Your role sees the totals only. Fund balances and the ledger are for the finance committee.

kutipan.title: Friday collections
kutipan.lead: One person counts, another confirms. Once confirmed, the receipt is recorded in the ledger automatically.
kutipan.countLead: Enter the amount counted. Someone else will confirm it.
kutipan.noFunds: There is no open fund yet. Ask the Pengerusi or Bendahari to add one.
kutipan.noteHint: Optional. For example: main door box.
kutipan.keptOffline: No signal. The count is kept on this phone and will be sent when there is signal.
kutipan.countBad: Note counts must be whole numbers.
kutipan.coinsBad: The coins total is not valid. For example: 12.50
kutipan.amountBad: The amount is not valid. For example: 1,234.50
kutipan.queueTitle: {count, plural, one {# count not sent} other {# counts not sent}}
kutipan.queueLead: These counts are kept on this phone only. They send themselves when there is signal.
kutipan.confirmDiscard: Remove this count from the phone? It has not been sent.
kutipan.hiddenLong: Hidden until confirmed, so the confirmer counts for themselves.
kutipan.resultCounted: Count saved. Ask another person (Pengerusi, Bendahari or AJK) to confirm it.
kutipan.resultConfirmed: Confirmed. Receipt {receipt} has been recorded in the ledger.
kutipan.resultReview: Your amount differs from the first count. This collection is marked "Needs checking" and is not in the ledger yet.
kutipan.reviewHelp: Count again together, then enter the agreed amount. Someone else will confirm it.
kutipan.waitForOther: You counted this collection. Another person needs to confirm it.
kutipan.confirmLead: Count the money yourself and enter your amount. If it matches, the receipt is recorded in the ledger. If not, the collection is marked for checking.
kutipan.recountLead: Enter the new amount. You become the counter, so someone else must confirm it.
kutipan.cancelLead: For a count entered by mistake. The record stays, with the reason.

kewangan.title: Finance
kewangan.lead: Cash book: every receipt and payment by fund.
kewangan.runningHint: Choose one fund only (with no other filters) to see the opening, running and closing balance.
kewangan.entries: {count, plural, =0 {No entries} one {# entry} other {# entries}}
kewangan.emailedOk: The receipt was emailed to the donor.
kewangan.emailedFailed: The entry is saved, but the receipt could not be emailed. Try again from the receipt page.

rekod.title: New entry
rekod.lead: Record money received or paid. Entries cannot be changed once saved; mistakes are corrected by cancelling.
rekod.fromCancelled: The original entry has been cancelled. Its details are filled in below: correct what was wrong, then save.
rekod.noFunds: There is no open fund to record into yet.
rekod.refHint: For example: receipt no., cheque no. or bank reference. Optional.
rekod.noteHint: What the money was for. Optional.
rekod.attachmentHint: Photo of the receipt or bill (JPG, PNG, WebP) or a PDF, up to 5 MB.
rekod.receivedFromHint: The donor's name as printed on the receipt. Leave empty for no name.
rekod.donorEmailHint: The receipt PDF is sent to this address. The address is not saved.
rekod.fromBank: Filled in from a bank statement line. Choose the fund and category, then save. The entry will be matched to that bank line.

transaksi.attachmentMissing: The attachment could not be opened.
transaksi.cancelLead: Nothing is deleted. A cancelling entry dated today takes the amount back out, and both stay in the ledger.
transaksi.confirmCancel: Cancel this entry? This cannot be undone.
transaksi.reasonHint: For example: wrong amount, wrong fund, entered twice.
transaksi.cancelThenEnter: After cancelling, a new-entry form opens with the same details so you can enter the correct one.
transaksi.cancelOnly: After cancelling, ask the Bendahari to enter the correct entry.

dana.title: Funds & categories
dana.lead: Funds keep separate balances. Categories describe the kind of receipt or payment.
dana.restrictedHelp: A restricted fund may only be used for its purpose (for example Pembangunan). It is marked "Restricted" on the dashboard and in reports.
dana.planNote: Asas plan: {used} of {limit} active funds used.
dana.archiveNeedsZero: Can be archived when the balance is RM 0.00.

resit.title: Receipts
resit.lead: Every receipt of money gets a numbered receipt. Download it, share to WhatsApp or email it.
resit.count: {count, plural, =0 {No receipts} one {# receipt} other {# receipts}}
resit.found: {count, plural, =0 {No matches} one {# match} other {# matches}}
resit.cancelledLead: This entry was cancelled on {date}. The receipt copy shows BATAL.
resit.shareLead: Opens WhatsApp with a short message in Malay and a link to the receipt. The link works for {days} days. The system sends no messages.
resit.shareOff: Share links are not set up for this app yet.
resit.whatsappMessage:
Assalamualaikum. Terima kasih atas sumbangan anda kepada {masjid}. Resit {number} ({amount}): {link}

Pautan sah selama {days} hari.
resit.emailHint: The address is used once to send and is not saved.
resit.emailOff: Email is not set up for this app yet.
resit.openEntry: View the entry in the ledger

resitPdf.title: Donation e-receipt
resitPdf.thanks: Thank you. May Allah accept your charity.
resitPdf.cancelledNote: This receipt was cancelled and is not valid.

resitKongsi.badTitle: This receipt link is not valid
resitKongsi.badBody: The link is incomplete or was changed. Ask the masjid to send a new link.
resitKongsi.expiredBody: For safety, receipt links only work for a limited time. Ask the masjid to send a new link.

resitEmel.subject: Resit {number} daripada {masjid}
resitEmel.body:
Assalamualaikum,

Terima kasih atas sumbangan anda sebanyak {amount} kepada {masjid}.

Resit {number} dilampirkan sebagai PDF.

Semoga Allah menerima sedekah anda.

resitTetapan.title: E-receipts
resitTetapan.lead: Settings for receipts made by the app.
resitTetapan.creditAsas: The Asas plan always shows "Generated by Imarah" at the bottom of receipts. Paid plans can hide it.

khairat.title: Khairat
khairat.upgradeTitle: Khairat is on Standard plans and above
khairat.upgradeBody: Khairat membership, yearly fees and the arrears list are on the Standard and Pro plans.
khairat.upgradeHowPengerusi: To upgrade, contact the Imarah team. Your masjid's plan is changed by the administrator.
khairat.upgradeHowOthers: Ask the Pengerusi to contact the Imarah team to upgrade.
khairat.noSetup: Khairat fees are not set up yet.
khairat.noSetupOthers: Ask the Pengerusi or Bendahari to set up khairat fees first.
khairat.enrolled: {count, plural, =0 {No new households enrolled.} one {# household enrolled.} other {# households enrolled.}}
khairat.renewHint: Enrols every member from last year who has not ended. Those already enrolled are not repeated.
khairat.count: {count, plural, =0 {No households} one {# household} other {# households}}
khairat.emptyYear: No households enrolled for this year yet.
khairat.paidBeforeImarah: Payment recorded before Imarah was used.
khairat.cancelHint: A wrong payment is cancelled from the ledger (Cancel entry). The amount paid goes down by itself.
khairat.openHousehold: View the household in the kariah
khairat.endLead: For example: moved away or passed away. The record stays and no more arrears are counted.
khairat.setupLead: The fee, who is covered, the last day to pay and the fund for payments.
khairat.enrolLead: Fee {fee} {coverage}. Tick the households that are joining.
khairat.allEnrolled: Every household in the kariah is already enrolled for this year.

coverageHints.household: One fee for the whole household.
coverageHints.person: The fee times the number of household members in the kariah (at least 1).

khairat.payByHint: After this date, those not paid in full are marked In arrears.
khairat.fundHint: Khairat payments are recorded into this fund.
khairat.amountHint: Part payments are allowed. It cannot be more than this year's balance.
khairat.confirmEnd: End this membership? It cannot be reopened.

derma.title: Receive donations
derma.lead: Show this QR to donors, or print it as a poster.
derma.direct: Money goes straight to the masjid's bank account. Imarah never holds or moves money.
derma.noneSetUp: Add the masjid's QR in Settings so donors can scan it here.
derma.noneAsk: Ask the Pengerusi to add the masjid's QR in Settings.

duitnow.title: DuitNow QR
duitnow.lead: The masjid's DuitNow QR is shown on the Receive donations screen and, if you choose, on receipts. The app only displays the QR; money goes straight to the masjid's bank account. No bank login details are stored.
duitnow.addLead: Upload a picture of the DuitNow QR from the masjid's bank, or paste the QR text. The picture is not kept; only the QR code is.
duitnow.uploadHint: PNG or JPG. A screenshot from the banking app works too.
duitnow.readFailed: The QR could not be read from this picture. Try a clearer picture, or paste the QR text.
duitnow.payloadHint: Starts with 000201. Filled in for you when the picture is read.
duitnow.confirm: I confirm this name is the masjid's bank account.
duitnow.removeConfirm: Remove the DuitNow QR? The Receive donations screen and receipts will stop showing it.
duitnow.receiptLead: Print the QR at the bottom of receipts so donors can give again.
duitnow.showOnReceipts: Show the DuitNow QR on receipts

bank.title: Bank matching
bank.lead: Import bank statements, match each line to a ledger entry, and bring this month's difference to RM 0.00.
bank.imported: {count, plural, =0 {No new lines.} one {# bank line imported.} other {# bank lines imported.}}
bank.locked: This month is locked. Matches cannot be changed.
bank.ledgerExplain: Ledger = bank transfer, DuitNow and cheque entries ({entries}) + cash deposits and withdrawals marked ({cash}). Cash entries are not counted because they do not go through the bank.
bank.empty: No bank lines for this month. Import a bank statement to start.
bank.unmatchedLinesLead: Accept a suggestion, or choose another way to explain the line.
bank.unmatchedEntries: Ledger entries not in the bank ({count})
bank.unmatchedEntriesLead: Non-cash entries this month with no bank line yet. Check whether they reached the bank in another month, or were recorded with the wrong method.
bank.otherMonthLead: Timing difference: the bank and the ledger record these in different months. This explains part of the difference.
bank.candidatesLead: Non-cash entries with the same amount and direction, not yet matched, closest date first.
bank.noCandidates: No ledger entry has this amount.
bank.daysAway: {days, plural, =0 {same day} one {# day} other {# days}}
bank.createEntryHint: The form is filled in with this line's date, amount and description. Once saved, it is matched by itself.
bank.markDepositHint: Cash (for example the Friday collection) paid into the bank. It is already in the ledger as a cash entry, so no new entry is needed.
bank.markWithdrawalHint: Money taken out of the bank as cash. The spending is recorded in the ledger as a cash entry when paid.

done.reject_bank_suggestion: Suggestion rejected. It will not be suggested again for this line.
done.cancel_bank_import: Import cancelled. Its lines have been taken out.

bankImport.title: Import a bank statement
bankImport.lead: Download the statement as CSV from internet banking, then upload it here. You choose the columns only once per bank. No bank login details are asked for or stored.
bankImport.step1Lead: A bank statement CSV for one month or more.
bankImport.fileHint: Up to 900 KB. Lines already imported are skipped.
bankImport.mapLead: Choose the columns holding the date, description and amount. This is saved for the next statement.
bankImport.sampleCaption: The first few lines of the file

kinds.splitHint: One column for money out, one for money in
kinds.singleHint: Money out has a minus (-), DR or brackets

bankImport.previewSummary: {fresh} new lines, {duplicate} already imported, {locked} in locked months.
bankImport.problems: Lines that could not be read (skipped):
bankImport.nothingNew: Every line in this file is already imported. Nothing is added.
bankImport.cancelHint: Cancel an import if the wrong columns were chosen. This works only before any of its lines is matched, and not for locked months.

tutupBulan.title: Close month
tutupBulan.lead: Lock months that have ended so their records cannot change any more. Official reports are produced from locked months.
tutupBulan.currentMonth: Current month: can be locked once it ends
tutupBulan.lockedLead: No record dated in this month can be added, changed or removed, by anyone. Cancelling an entry from this month is recorded in the current month.
tutupBulan.notEnded: This month has not ended, so it cannot be locked yet.
tutupBulan.checklistLead: Collections not yet confirmed must be dealt with first. Everything else is a warning.

collections.problem: {count, plural, one {# collection not confirmed or waiting for a recount} other {# collections not confirmed or waiting for a recount}}
collections.hint: Confirm, recount or cancel these first. Once the month is locked they can never be confirmed.

noStatement.problem: {count, plural, one {No bank statement imported, but there is # non-cash entry} other {No bank statement imported, but there are # non-cash entries}}
noStatement.hint: Import this month's bank statement to make sure the bank entries are right.

bankLines.problem: {count, plural, one {# bank line not matched} other {# bank lines not matched}}
bankLines.hint: Match it, create an entry or mark it as cash.

bankDifference.ok: Bank and ledger differ by RM 0.00
bankDifference.hint: See what is not matched on the Bank matching screen.

entries.ok: Every non-cash entry is in the bank
entries.problem: {count, plural, one {# non-cash entry not in the bank} other {# non-cash entries not in the bank}}
entries.hint: Perhaps a cheque not yet cashed, or an entry recorded with the wrong method.

drafts.hint: Collection counts saved on a phone without internet and not yet sent cannot be seen here. Ask the counter to send them first.

tutupBulan.blocked: This month cannot be locked yet because a collection is not finished.
tutupBulan.understood: {count, plural, one {I have read the warning above and want to lock anyway} other {I have read the # warnings above and want to lock anyway}}
tutupBulan.lockLead: Once locked, nobody can add or change a record dated in this month until the Pengerusi unlocks it with a reason.
tutupBulan.onlyPengerusi: Only the Pengerusi can lock a month.
tutupBulan.reasonHint: For example: Fix an electricity bill recorded in the wrong fund. The reason is kept in the audit log.
tutupBulan.doneUnlocked: Unlocked. Reports for this month are now marked no longer valid until produced again.
tutupBulan.reportsHint: When a month is unlocked, its reports (and the yearly reports) are marked no longer valid. Produce them again after locking.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.lead: Every addition, change and removal is recorded here automatically. Nobody can change or delete this log. Personal data is not kept in the log.
audit.otherUser: Not a masjid member (for example the platform admin)
